data.one_liner: A customizable circular checkbox with animated check/uncheck transitions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a circular checkbox widget that animates when its value changes. Developers can choose from four animation styles and customize colors for active, inactive, and disabled states. The widget works across all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need a small, animated checkbox with custom colors
You want a lightweight widget without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You require a full form solution or validation logic
weaknesses: Only provides a checkbox, no form integration
May not match Material design exactly
data.minimal_example:
class Example extends StatefulWidget {Example({Key? key}): super(key: key);@override State<Example> createState() => _ExampleState();}

class _ExampleState extends State<Example> {bool isChecked = false;@override Widget build(BuildContext context) {return Center(child: MSHCheckbox(size: 60,value: isChecked,colorConfig: MSHColorConfig.fromCheckedUncheckedDisabled(checkedColor: Colors.blue,),style: MSHCheckboxStyle.stroke,onChanged: (selected){setState((){isChecked = selected;});},),);}}
